audience: project managers and teams that track work on boards in Plaky

useCases.title: Find items still open on a board
useCases.text: Read a board's fields and groups, then list its items and read one item's field values.

useCases.title: Create a task in a board group
useCases.text: List the groups of a board, then create an item in one group. Each call creates a new item.

useCases.title: Update a status and leave a comment
useCases.text: Set one field value on an item, then add a comment that explains the change.

useCases.title: Find the files attached to an item
useCases.text: List the files of one item, then get a short-lived download link for one file.
